gates.name: nonnegative holdout return
gates.rationale: Reject a candidate that loses money in the protected holdout.

gates.name: holdout Sharpe floor
gates.rationale: Apply the approved validation Sharpe floor to the protected holdout.

gates.name: holdout drawdown cap
gates.rationale: Apply the approved validation drawdown cap to the protected holdout.

gates.name: holdout gross exposure cap
gates.rationale: Keep average holdout exposure within fully invested unlevered capital.

gates.name: holdout session profit concentration cap
gates.rationale: Apply the approved session concentration cap to the protected holdout.

gates.name: holdout instrument profit concentration cap
gates.rationale: Apply the approved instrument concentration cap to the protected holdout.

gates.name: holdout turnover cap
gates.rationale: Apply the approved turnover cap to the protected holdout.
